description_html: The Company     PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.     We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.    We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.     Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.       Job Summary:  PayPal Credit’s Developer Experience (DevEx) team designs, deploys, and operates cloud-native platforms supporting Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), consumer revolving credit, and merchant lending products across AWS, on-premises environments, and PayPal’s modernization strategy into GCP. DevEx partners with business, product, Security, Compliance, Audit, Edge, and Networking teams to deliver innovative infrastructure, reduce friction, streamline operations, and accelerate product launches.  We are seeking a Manager, Systems & Cloud Engineering to lead Cloud Infrastructure Engineers and serve as a strategic product partner. This role will own the roadmap for platforms, tools, and service architecture supporting PayPal Credit, including the Loan Management System built on Apache Fineract. The manager will align resources to business priorities, partner with security, audit, and compliance stakeholders, and oversee budgets and vendors.    Job Description:    Essential Responsibilities:     Lead a team of highly skilled network engineers, providing technical guidance and support.  Develop and manage both long-term and short-term strategic transformation plans.  Implement scalable global connectivity solutions and oversee all phases of project lifecycles.  Work with cross-functional teams to address hybrid cloud connectivity requirements.  Champion the development of network lifecycle automation and visibility/telemetry tools.  Drive business outcomes by acting as a customer advocate.  Vendor Relationship Management: Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and influence the vendor community's roadmap.  Co-lead initiatives in industry innovations.      Minimum Qualifications:    5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.                 Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications :                Additional Responsibilities    Own the DevEx product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog by translating business priorities and developer feedback into JIRA epics that define the team’s work.  Lead, coach, hire, and develop a team of infrastructure engineers, including performance management and career growth.  Direct the design, deployment, and operation of infrastructure powering PayPal Credit's Loan Management System and lending products, spanning AWS and on premises environments, certificate lifecycle management, patching, disaster recovery, and resiliency testing.  Serve as the primary partner for Security, Audit, and Compliance, overseeing vulnerability remediation, PCI/SOX requirements, access reviews, and audit responses.  Manage AWS budgets, vendor relationships, purchase orders, invoices, forecasting, and cost-optimization initiatives.  Partner with development and business teams to remove delivery blockers and identify new platforms, tools, and partnerships that support product launches and revenue growth.     Preferred Qualifications    2+ years of direct engineering management experience, preferably in DevOps, SRE, cloud, or infrastructure engineering. Prior experience as an engineer in one of these disciplines is a plus.  Experience owning technical product roadmaps and translating business priorities into actionable backlogs.  Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD and deployment tooling, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), scripting, and monitoring and observability platforms (Datadog, Splunk).  Experience managing cloud budgets, optimizing infrastructure costs, and using tools such as AWS Cost Explorer, tagging, and committed-use discounts.  Experience managing vulnerabilities and partnering with security teams and auditors on PCI, SOX, cloud security, and access-control requirements.  Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to represent technical roadmaps to senior leadership, security, and audit partners.      Subsidiary:  PayPal    Travel Percent:  0         -     The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. The expected range of pay for this role by location is:&#xa;    Primary Location | Pay Range:  Chicago, Illinois: ($160,500.00 - $238,700.00 Annually)&#xa;   Additional Location(s) | Pay Range:  No other locations are assigned to this requisition currently.&#xa;&#xa;Additional compensation for this role may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable.    PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes.  Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately.  To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit  https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us .      For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.     Our Benefits:   At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. title: Solution Architect - Marketing cloud/Data360
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Customer Success    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        Marketing Cloud & Data 360 Solution Architect   DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION   Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team's expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.   OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE   Salesforce is currently seeking a  Marketing Cloud & Data 360 Solution Architect  to join our Professional Services team within Professional Services. This role is centered on being a "Data & Engagement" subject matter expert, leading the design and implementation of enterprise-grade customer engagement and data management solutions.  Marketing Cloud and Data 360 expertise is required  (similar Martech and CDP expertise is also acceptable), to drive cross-cloud success and unlock enterprise AI and personalization use cases. Deeper Data 360 specialization is considered a plus on top of this core requirement. The Solution Architect is responsible for architecting scalable, data-driven engagement solutions across enterprise landscapes, ensuring customer data is unified, governed, and activated effectively across channels. You will work closely with Project Managers and Technical Architects to ensure on-time, fully functioning integrations. The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial atmosphere, communicates tactfully with business operations, and effectively designs, tests, and deploys complex marketing and data solutions. You must be an excellent communicator who can tailor delivery to a variety of audiences.   YOUR IMPACT   Through our extended onboarding program of formal certification, internal training, knowledge transfer, hands-on experience and closely working with other Consultants, Architects and Project Managers you will become a Salesforce Domain Authority at the forefront of our offerings, delivering outstanding customer success.     Become a Trusted SME:  Act as the primary authority for Marketing Cloud and Data 360 to support project delivery, including how data and engagement architecture relate to the success of Agentforce and AI-driven personalization.   Strategic Design:  Drive the creation of application and technical design documents (Blueprints/FSD) which leverage Salesforce best practices and effectively integrate Salesforce into the customer's infrastructure.   Unified Customer Engagement:  Design and guide customer's enterprise data and engagement architecture, highlighting the importance of Data Governance, consent management, and ensuring solutions adhere to security and privacy regulations.   Technical Excellence:  Provide guidance on integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, and environment management. Lead code reviews and define coding standards (SQL, SSJS, AMPScript).   Stakeholder Management:  Facilitate and influence Executive Customer stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI.   Risk Mitigation:  Troubleshoot key customer implementation issues and demonstrate the ability to drive to a successful resolution through proactive risk management.    REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS     Fluent in English and French  Marketing Cloud and Data 360 Expertise:  Direct, hands-on experience designing and configuring Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio) and Data 360 — Ingestion, Unified Profile, Insights, and Activation — and how they integrate . Equivalent experience with a similar Martech or CDP platform is also acceptable.   Martech Expertise  : Deep expertise of Martech Ecosysem, Customer journey orchestration, Digital campaign management and Optimization   Architectural Proficiency:  Solid understanding of system designs and integration patterns, data modeling, MDM, development Lifecycle and Deployment (DevOps)   Solution Documentation:  Ability to clearly and articulately document solutions, including data flows, engineering flowcharts, and technical artifacts.   Requirement Translation:  Ability to create a solution based on client requirements and map business processes into our technical product suite.   Cross-Cloud Integration:  Knowledge of API patterns (REST/SOAP) and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CRM, data lakes).   Technical Leadership:  Lead inter-team meetings on technical and business challenges; conduct solutions testing and validation.   Mobility:  Travel to client sites for onsite discovery and solutions presentations (estimated 25%-50%).   Education:  Engineering School Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.    PREFERRED     Marketing Cloud Expertise  : 6+ Years of direct experience with Marketing Cloud, including designing and building multi-channel journeys, increase customer engagement and optimize campaigns ROI.   Data 360 Mastery:  2+ years of direct experience with Data 360, including advanced Unified Profile and Activation design.   AI :  Familiarity with Agentforce   Strategic Communication:  Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, able to present complex concepts at both tactical and executive levels.   Data Background:  6+ years in marketing technology or data architecture consulting, with a focus on relational data models and SQL.   Ecosystem Knowledge:  Familiarity with external data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP) and functional domains such as Finance, Telco, or Retail.   Certifications:    Highly Regarded:  Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Consultant and/or Marketing Cloud Developer.   Preferred:  Salesforce Certified Data 360 Consultant, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Administrator.     Adaptability:  Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, fluid environment and remain "scrappy" as we scale and evolve our team.     Please be aware that all interviews will take place on-site at our Casablanca office            Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our      Candidate Privacy Statement      for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.        Posting Statement     Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.    Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.    Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
